title: OPERATIONS AND SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT
description: Provides an overview of the functional activities necessary for the creation/delivery of goods and services. Topics covered include productivity; strategy in a global business environment; project management; quality management; location and layout strategies; supply chain and inventory management; material requirements planning; JIT; work-place safety; maintenance and reliability; sourcing and sustainability.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 275 or 275H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 275 and BA 275H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistic Manage (045)
  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Management (196)
  • Pre-MBA (205)
  • Business Administration (2050)
  • Business (2067)
  • Energy Systems Engineering (293)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Food Manufacturing (797)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Pre-MSB (837)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
recommendations: Good working knowledge of Excel applications
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 12pm-1:50pm in LINC 210 - Learning Innovation Center 210 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
